The fourth LegsA leg-curl set is one HE accepted on 2026-08-23, in a pair of cards that moved the set off LegsB rather than adding it — the LegsB card told him in writing that declining was a real answer and he accepted anyway. Presenting his own accepted decision as a third instance of a count being imposed on him misstates the record, and it was the whole load-bearing argument for my cut. Setting that aside, this seat has no recovery grounds left: the 2026-08-20 log shows 127.5x15 then 142.5x13 and 142.5x13 with no rep decay between the two working sets and no pain note, and 2026-08-29 through 2026-08-31 were full rest days, so the hamstring-proximity argument from the 265 deadlift on 2026-08-28 is weaker tonight than it was on 08-31. I hold the standing four sets. The load stays 142.5, where he already works — I do not ratify any increase above it under this hold. Tonight is the first LegsA to actually run four; if reps fall on the fourth set, that is the signal, and it will be in the log for the next panel rather than assumed now.
